stem.en: Here you are. ___ is your pencil.

why.en: One thing near you: this. This is your pencil.
why.uz: Yaqiningizdagi bitta narsa: this. This is your pencil.
why.ru: Один предмет рядом с вами: this. This is your pencil.

stem.en: I have a dog. ___ dog is big.

why.en: Before the word dog we say my, not I or me: My dog is big.
why.uz: Dog soʻzi oldidan my keladi, I yoki me emas: My dog is big.
why.ru: Перед словом dog ставим my, а не I или me: My dog is big.

why.en: We ask another person: What is your name? Before name we say your, not you.
why.uz: Boshqa odamdan shunday soʻraymiz: What is your name? Name oldidan your keladi, you emas.
why.ru: Так спрашивают другого человека: What is your name? Перед name ставим your, а не you.

stem.en: This is my pen. Where is ___ pen, Sardor?

why.en: We ask Sardor about his pen. Before the word pen we say your, not you: your pen.

why.ru: Мы спрашиваем Сардора о его ручке. Перед словом pen ставим your, а не you: your pen.

why.ru: Когда предметов два или больше, добавляем -s: one book, two books.
